## Changes since v0.8.1

### External MCP, Skill, and host plugins

- Unified publication protocol: `figure_library_plan_publish` collects exactly one candidate or working selector into a session-local plan (expires after 30 minutes) that shows the final bilingual metadata, asset inventory, exact preview, digest and technical review, host Gallery actions, and similar candidates in a single human review; `figure_library_apply_publish` applies it after approval. Default target is Local Published; `open_module` is explicit and ends at a pull request that is never auto-merged.
- Durable operation journals bind each plan to its completed stages: a confirmed partial operation resumes across restart with the same `operationId`, completed operations replay without duplicate releases or PRs, and a failed public submission keeps Local Published.
- Optional readable English titles (`titleEn`) are persisted on new revisions and projected to Local search, detail, materialization metadata and Open Module; old records stay readable and are not rewritten, and cards show the English title as an ordinary grey subtitle.
- The figure-library Skill gains "Recreate and publish templates" guidance (proposal fields, recovery, provenance/execution truth kept in technical metadata); the legacy fine-grained publish operations remain supported.

### Local clients

- Favorites: star cards or details in the macOS app and Windows/Linux local web, with a dedicated Favorites page searchable by name, source and purpose. Favorites are stored per machine under the user config directory, keyed by source-qualified exact selector, and survive restarts; clearing caches or backing up the Library does not include them.
- Personal custom tags: edit comma-separated tags on gallery and My Library cards/details (up to 20 tags of 40 characters each, normalized and de-duplicated), and filter gallery and My Library results with the custom-tag dropdown combined with keyword and source filters. Tags are isolated per bound Library ID and follow the source entry, not a single revision; they live in the local config directory and are not synced or included in Library backups.
- Client update checks: after connecting, macOS and Windows/Linux clients check the latest stable GitHub Release in the background and show a notice with the current and latest version; Settings → Client update offers a manual check. Checks use existing proxy settings, never GitHub credentials, time out after 10 seconds, and cache results (1 hour success / 1 minute failure). Updates are installed manually from the release page; nothing is auto-downloaded and the Library is never migrated automatically.

### Gallery, cache, and library browsing

- Docs: new Pi getting-started tutorial (docs/PI_TUTORIAL.zh-CN.md); README warns against `pi install` from a GitHub URL or git clone because the repository does not contain `dist/`.
- Release packaging: the npm tarball is published by absolute path in the release workflow.

## 相对 v0.8.1 的变化

### 外部 MCP、Skill 与宿主插件

- 统一发布协议：`figure_library_plan_publish` 把一个候选或 Working 选择器收集为会话内计划（30 分钟后过期），在唯一一次人工确认中展示最终中英元数据、资产清单、精确预览、摘要与技术评审、宿主 Gallery 动作以及相似候选；`figure_library_apply_publish` 在确认后应用计划。默认只发布到 Local Published；`open_module` 需显式指定，止步于 PR，绝不自动合并。
- 持久化操作日志把计划与已完成阶段绑定：同一 `operationId` 可在重启后继续已确认的部分操作，已完成操作重放不会产生重复发布或 PR；公开发布失败时保留 Local Published。
- 可读英文标题（`titleEn`）随新修订持久化，并投射到 Local 搜索、详情、材料化元数据与 Open Module；旧记录仍可读且不会被改写，卡片以普通灰色副标题显示英文标题。
- figure-library Skill 新增「复刻并发布模板」指导（提案字段、恢复方式、来源与执行信息保留在技术元数据中）；原有细粒度发布操作继续可用。

### 本地客户端

- 收藏：在 macOS 客户端和 Windows/Linux 本地网页的卡片或详情点击星标，独立「收藏」页支持按名称、来源和用途搜索。收藏保存在本机用户配置目录，按来源限定的精确选择器区分版本，重启后保留；清理缓存和图库备份都不包含收藏。
- 个人自定义标签：在图库与「我的图库」的卡片/详情编辑逗号分隔的标签（每条目最多 20 个、每个 40 字符，规范化并去重），图库与「我的图库」可用「自定义标签」下拉框筛选并与关键词、来源组合。标签按已绑定图库隔离，跟随同一来源的条目而非单个修订；保存在本机配置目录，不同步、不进入图库备份。
- 客户端更新检查：macOS 与 Windows/Linux 客户端连接本地服务后，后台检查官方最新稳定 Release，发现新版时提示当前与最新版本；设置 →「客户端更新」可手动检查。检查使用已有代理设置、不使用 GitHub 凭据、限时 10 秒并缓存结果（成功 1 小时、失败 1 分钟）。更新需在发布页手动选择安装包安装，不自动下载，也不自动迁移图库。

### 图库、缓存与本地浏览

- 文档：新增 Pi 入门教程（docs/PI_TUTORIAL.zh-CN.md）；README 提醒不要从 GitHub URL 或 git clone 执行 `pi install`，因为仓库不含 `dist/`。
- 发布打包：release 工作流改为按绝对路径发布 npm tarball。
